explanation: I searched Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for nilradical, radical_bot, isReduced_iff and `IsReduced … ↔` statements. Mathlib has `Scheme.nilradical_eq_bot` ([IsReduced X] → X.nilradical = ⊥), which is only the forward direction. It has no converse, and no iff relating `IsReduced Y` to `Y.nilradical = ⊥`. The related lemmas `IsReduced.iff_of_openCover` and `affine_isReduced_iff` are about open covers and affine schemes. The converse needs real work: the proof passes to an affine open cover and uses injectivity of the open-immersion map on global sections. So it is not a one- or two-line derivation.
